door_note: process_ms_* and spawns are the COLD door (python script, or COORDINATOR_WARM=0 for coordinator-invoke): the only figure that counts all of the op's CPU inside the measured process tree. warm_door_* is the .exe forwarder's tree; the warm server's own CPU is outside that tree and cannot be isolated on a server shared by peers, so a warm figure is a door cost, never an op cost. cost_class is set from the cold median against the 500ms bar.

tier_u_grant.note: tier-u-grant-cli grant ceremony workday-complete --ceremony workday-complete: writes a grant record; mutating, not run.

assemble_brief.note: workday-complete-assemble brief; 27 to 35 procs cold (it runs the dirty-tree dry-run probe and the open-goal read inside).

structural_index_refresh.note: structural-index-refresh: runs example-retrieval-repo ensure and may start a detached cold build of about 3 minutes; mutates the index, not run.

fleet_scratch_hygiene.note: fleet.scratch_hygiene cadence workday_complete: apply=false measured as a floor; the apply=true leg deletes and is not run.

git_maintenance_daily.note: git.maintenance tier daily: mutating, not run; network-free by design (no prefetch); the module docstring cites about 392ms for the tier, a derived figure, not a sample.

emitted_workflow_sweep.note: DoE Step 9e: engine prune of state/**/fire-*.mjs plus git rm --cached and a commit; mutating, not run.

claudemeta_cadence.note: state/reference/generate-claudemeta-manifest.py --cadence: regenerates and commits only on drift; not run.

node_plugin_ecosystem_suite.note: DoE Step 3-4: node --test coordinator/tests/plugin-ecosystem/run.js; a test suite, not run; a hook-behavior failure blocks the body today.

d_step1_validate.note: workday-complete-args-and-validate run-step1 -> workday-complete-step1-validate.py execs coordinator.local.md fast_test_cmd (python3 -m pytest -m 'not cadence and not pending_fix and not designed_red' -n auto --maxprocesses=7 --timeout=300); Tier-U gated; not run.

d_step1_5_cruft_sweep.note: workday-complete-reconcile cruft-sweep -> cruft-sweep.py --class all --apply --quiet; deletes cruft; not run.

d_step2_5_dirty_tree_scan.note: Measured with --dry-run (rc 2 is NEEDS-PM, a report). The directive's real run also commits claimed paths, so this is a floor on the step; the op accepts --dry-run only.

d_step2_66_reap_claims.note: reap-claims-for-repos; reaps claim records; not run.

d_step2_67_handoff_housekeeping.note: Measured with --dry-run. The directive's real run closes, files and commits handoffs, so this is a floor on the step.

d_step3_consolidate.note: workday-complete-step3-consolidate: merges same-day sibling work/<machine>/ branches into the current branch, rebases or merges origin/main into it, pushes the current branch (force-with-lease after a history rewrite, else push_outstanding). Refuses main/master. Not run.

d_step3_5_backfill_scan.note: workday-complete-backfill-scan --lookback 14 --repo-root <root>; read-only; its TSV is read on stdin by d_step3_5_backfill_anchor_a0 and d_step3_5_backfill_phase_b.

d_step3_5_backfill_anchor_a0.note: workday-complete-backfill-anchor run <root> --allow-empty: injects anchors and makes one batched commit; reads the scan's TSV on stdin; not run.

d_step3_5_backfill_phase_b.note: workday-complete-close backfill-dispatch-rows: one step9-dispatch subprocess per stdin row, each appends a changelog block and pushes (--no-push exists); not run.

d_step7_5_prune_closed_bugs.note: prune-closed-bugs --repo-root <root>: the real run deletes closed bug files; --dry-run measured as a floor, close to the bar.

d_step9_changelog.note: workday-complete-close step9-dispatch: appends the changelog block, commits and pushes the current branch (--no-push exists); not run.

d_goal_close_day.note: goal-close-day --decisions <json>: appends goal close rows; emitted only when an open day goal exists; not run.

d_step10_5_post_command_hook.note: coordinator-ceremony-hook workday-complete: execs the repo's configured workday_complete_post_command, an arbitrary command; not run.
